notes.title: Storage Kings is now Salvage Shop Simulator! Demo Live Now!
notes.content:
Oh boy, how many years has it been? Over 7!



At that time we wanted to create Storage Kings, but lack of budget caused the project to be put on hold.

But this year it returns with double force as Salvage Shop Simulator:



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555500/Salvage_Shop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]

The game concept has been expanded, there will be more features related to store management, like the real Storage King does.


We have just launched the alpha demo version of the game to gather feedback and ideas.
[previewyoutube="zEKiTIxKUpA;full"][/previewyoutube]
In this vertical slice, you'll:

Join your first container auction

Search through salvaged items and bid against NPCs

Clean and appraise what you win

Sell items in your shop and set your own prices

Learn the core gameplay loop of acquiring, trading and growing your business!



Try your hand at bidding!

Cheers
